public_body: Christa Mcauliffe Regional Charter School Special Education Parent Advisory Council
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the SEP AC held no meetings in 2012-2013 because it was not constituted then, so no minutes existed to be released within 10 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the SEP AC failed to provide minutes of its 2012-2013 open session meetings within 10 days of a records request.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the SEP AC did not hold any meeting during the 2012-2013 school year.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board, acting for the SEP AC, failed to respond to the minutes request within 10 days.
allegations.key_passage: Thus neither the Board nor the SEPAC violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to make minutes available within 10 days of a request.
